## Summary: Key Genealogical Findings

### Patrick Gleeson (primary subject)
- Identified as **Farmer** residing in **Scagh / Scaugh** (townland), County Limerick (Croom Petty Sessions area)
- Also referenced as **Donoman / Donaman West** (another townland in same area)
- Appears in Croom Petty Sessions court records: **1857, 1859, 1864**
  - Sept 1859: Charged with being drunk in Croom street; also involved in dispute with Acting Constable Thomas Turner
  - Oct 1859: One pig wandering public road; charged with assault at Croom Workhouse; "Defendant now dangerous Lunatic" noted in one entry; escaped from Croom workhouse taking clothing
  - July 1864: Defendant (along with Mich Kelly, John Fitz Gerald); charges include assault, drunk, horse wandering, leaving service without consent
- Also appears as **Pat Gleeson, age 26, Limerick** on an England/British merchant vessel Crew List, 1860 (alongside John Moloney 23 Limerick, Edward Moloney 24 Clare)
- **Patrick Gleeson, Watergrasshill**, County Cork — listed as complainant against Michael Regan Junior in Rathcormack Court Records 1857–1864, 1861 entry
- **Patrick Gleeson** in 1901 Will Index: named as Husband of Mary Gleeson, Farmer (Upperchurch, Co. Tipperary) — may or may not be same person

### Moloney / Margaret Moloney Connections
- **Margaret Moloney** as widow: Multiple Margaret Moloneys in Will Indexes — closest geographically: Margaret Moloney, widow of Andrew Moloney (Miltown Malbay, Co. Clare, died 1898); Margaret Moloney, widow of John Moloney (Derryfadda, Clonlara, Co. Clare, died 1907); Margaret Moloney late of Ballinscola, Herbertstown, Co. Limerick, widow, died December 1906
- **Gerald William Moloney Gleeson** — notable combined surname; Esquire of Tinarana, Killaloe, Co. Clare, died Oct 1906; estate £72,050. Executors: Robert Smyth and Florence Gleeson (widow). Suggests Gleeson-Moloney family connection in Clare/Limerick area
- Moloney-Gleeson surname combination also appears in the 1873 Deeds transcript: "Edward Moloney Gleeson of the one part and Frank Bradshaw Henshaw…"

### Notable Co-Occurrences in Records
